hook: Your coding agent can train itself while you sleep.
hookText: Your coding agent can train itself while you sleep.

beats.say: Songe is a training engine for your local model. While you work, it watches what happens after each of the model's actions: the tool result, the error, your next message.
When your agent is quiet, it teaches the model to see those outcomes coming, and a new version is used only if it passes its checks.
Nothing ever leaves your machine, and you install it with one command: uv tool install songe.
